The bookcase appears to have a unique design with curved or irregular shelves rather than standard straight horizontal ones. To the left, there is a black wire-frame object (possibly a lamp or stand). The lighting is somewhat dim and warm.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The shelves do not behave like rigid planes. They warp, dip, and seem to melt into the vertical supports. The geometry defies standard carpentry physics, suggesting AI generation failure in maintaining rigid body structures.
The vertical lines of the bookcase bow outward and inward inconsistently. While wide-angle lenses cause distortion, this looks more like generative warping where the edges lack straightness.

artifact_observations.location: Intersection of shelves and side panels
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundaries between the horizontal shelves and the vertical sides are blurry and indistinct in several areas, appearing fused rather than joined at clear right angles.
The spines of the books lack crisp text and distinct separation. Many blend into each other or the shelf background, typical of AI difficulty with dense, small repetitive objects.
